spec_match.rationale: Probes independently for both LanguageDetector and Translator API support and provides distinct status bars for each.

interactive.rationale: Features an interactive custom message composer, multiple inbox presets, reader locale selection, confidence threshold adjustments, and live-updating statistics counts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Superb and complete implementation of the canonical detect-then-translate pipeline.

edge_cases.rationale: Implements full token matching heuristics and mock translation mappings so the entire inbox pipeline operates perfectly on older browsers.

design_system.rationale: Exhibits flawless compliance with the project's design system variables and responsive width rules.
